description: The signature v4 (retooled 2026-06-15) behavior: a coach's snapshot, NOT a market report. The Read leads with the WEEK (mileage + a point of view), names the hard days and calls out the LONG RUN specifically, quotes fitness as a RANGE with confidence, and carries the goal as a light backdrop. It must NOT stack market-report tells: no percentage load-deltas (up ~18%), no pace-drift arrows (7:35 → 7:24), no HR-drift figures, no ACWR, no seconds-precision finish time. Replaces the old 005-load-led-windowed cassette, which asserted exactly the voice this revision removes. recorded_response is an authored target exemplar — re-record against the live model (gemini-3.1-pro-preview) via _evals/record.ts before trusting it as a regression baseline.
